_comment: Job queue for the autonomous Colab GPU worker (scripts/colab_worker.py). Claude edits this to request experiments; the worker runs any job whose results/auto/<id>/summary.csv does not yet exist, then commits + pushes results. Keep jobs small enough to finish within a Colab session.

jobs.note: Honest baseline: all 6 existing algorithms across 4 datasets x 3 seeds. This is the bar our novel method must beat.
